scope: isolated prototype; real EPUB selected chapter, CBZ and PDF; portrait phone viewport; single-to-double reflow

comparison_setup.layout: Before each measurement, prepare single-page with retained session, then time the complete double-page prepare operation including end-of-frame waits and cleanup. Reopen mode closes the source after the old cache settles; reuse mode retains it. Same shader, resolution and textures.
comparison_setup.source_selection: Same selected EPUB chapter and first page window in all cases; not complete-book coverage.

trace_finding: Slow native raster frames spend most wall time inside QueuePresentKHR / queueBuffer / waitForever. Flat rendering can also show high raster duration. This does not isolate GPU execution or establish the underlying driver/compositor cause.
limitations: Only two prepare samples per policy per format; CBZ difference is not a demonstrated speedup.
The improvement is reflow preparation, not warm curl frame speed or cold launch time.
Native tracing perturbs timings. Raw traces and book screenshots remain private temporary files; only numeric summaries are retained.
Raster wall time includes waits; budget exceedance does not establish dropped frames. Stable 120 Hz is not claimed.
Cache remains bounded at 32 MiB RGBA; no claim that total process RSS falls by the same percentage.
No new iOS, tablet or desktop real-book validation; no production reader integration or persisted book data.
